{{Quote|Get out of my bar. You always cause trouble.|Timmy to Kyle Katarn|audio=NarShadBartender-AlwaysCauseTrouble.flac|<ref name="DF2" />}}
'''Timmy''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] that worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at the [[Rimmer's Rest/Legends|Rimmer's Rest]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. During that year, the Rimmer's Rest became a meeting spot for the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] and the occasional [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]], which eventually heightened into a [[Lightfight|shootout]] between Katarn and 8t88's [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hired guns]]. After the violence subsided, leaving the bar littered with bodies, the bartender ordered Katarn out of the Rimmer's Rest. Katarn did leave, but not before taking the Timmy's [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and [[Energy cell/Legends|spare ammunition]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|&hellip;and tell the server to bring me some Norvanian ''[sic]'' grog."<br />"Timmy! Grog! Table four!|The bouncer gives Timmy Katarn's drink order|audio=NarShaddBouncer-TimmyGrogTableFour.flac|<ref name="AudioD" />}}
[[File:Rimmers_Rest_interior.png|thumb|right|225px|Timmy mans the bar at the Rimmer's Rest.]]
Timmy<ref name="AudioD">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref> was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] that served the<ref name="DF2" /> [[Rimmer's Rest/Legends|Rimmer's Rest]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], a well-stocked establishment that catered to various [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref> on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]]<ref name="DF2" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> Timmy at some point became acquainted with [[Kyle Katarn]], an occasional [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="DF2" /> A previous patron,<ref name="AudioD" /> the bartender eventually reached the belief that Katarn was a troublemaker.<ref name="DF2" />

One [[Standard day/Legends|day]]<ref name="AudioD" /> during 5 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> the Rimmer's Rest [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|was patronized]] by Katarn and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]], who had arranged a meeting at the cantina. Meanwhile, the bar's [[Unidentified bouncer|bouncer]] gave Timmy Katarn's drink order, [[Novanian grog/Legends|Novanian grog]]. Katarn's and 8t88's conversation quickly turned sour, however, and 8t88 left a little while later after ordering a number of hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Katarn in the bar.<ref name="AudioD" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II}}
Despite being outgunned, Katarn dealt with the attackers and, in short order, knocked out a [[Grave Tuskens|Tusken]] [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Rimmer's Rest)|grave robber]] and killed [[Unidentified Gran (Rimmer's Rest)|two]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]]. After the last aggressor in the bar fell, Timmy sternly ordered Katarn to leave, vaguely recalling a past disturbance Katarn had caused.<ref name="DF2" />

Before leaving, though, Katarn first jumped behind the bar to grab Timmy's hidden [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] and the spare ammunition on a shelf, in addition to taking any [[Personal energy shield/Legends|energy shield belts]] lying in the establishment.<ref name="DF2" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I know nothing.|Timmy refuses further conversation with Katarn|audio=NarShadBartender-KnowsNothing.flac|<ref name="DF2" />}}
After Katarn shot up the Rimmer's Rest, Timmy adopted a gruff demeanor as he ordered Katarn out. Any attempt by Katarn to further communicate with the bartender was met with impatient dismissal.<ref name="DF2" />

A surly individual,<ref name="DF2-Guide">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> Timmy had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and was fair-skinned.<ref name="DF2" />

==Equipment==
Timmy kept an E-11 blaster rifle behind the bar counter and kept spare [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cells]] on a shelf alongside glassware. All of these items were later taken by Katarn before he left the Rimmer's Rest.<ref name="DF2" />

He wore blue, gray, brown, and black [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] on the day of Katarn's and 8t88's meeting.<ref name="DF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Timmy first appeared as an unnamed non-player character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', where he shared a character model with other male NPCs that appeared throughout the game, with his lines of unique dialogue setting him apart from the others.<ref name="DF2" />

Although the character did not appear in the [[1997]] novella ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'', he nonetheless received a mention in the novella's [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|audio adaption]], which also served as the first source to supply the character with a name. However, as his name is only delivered in shouted dialogue, the exact pronunciation and spelling of his name is unknown and conjectural, respectively.<ref name="AudioD" />
